ROSIE • BOOST GUIDE

Read Rosie’s introduction

Hi, it’s Rosie again. So far, you’ve explored careers that fit your interests and taken a closer look at which ones hold up in the real world. Now it’s time to look at something just as important: what you already bring. This is Career Mobility. In this module, you’ll look at your current or most recent work experience, the skills and work activities you already use, and how those strengths may connect to the careers you explored in Module 2. You’ll see three different ways your skills can travel. Work Now shows careers that may be within reach right now using much of what you already bring. Move Now shows careers where your skills transfer well, but you may need some added experience, employer training, or short-term development. Build Toward shows longer-term career options that may be a strong fit, but likely require more education, a credential, licensing, or additional preparation. This module is not about starting over. It’s about seeing how far your current skills, experience, and strengths can take you. By the end, you’ll have a clearer picture of where you can work now, where you can move next, and what careers may be worth building toward over time. When you’re ready, let’s see where your skills can take you.

Ready to see what already travels with you?

Nothing is being re-entered from Modules 1 and 2. Career Mobility reads the shared journey record and adds a new layer of evidence.

Step 1 • Your Starting Point

What experience are you bringing with you?

Choose the option that best describes your current starting point. This is not a résumé test — it helps BOOST identify skills you may already be using.

Choose your starting point. If you selected work experience, choose an occupation from the search results.
Step 2 • What You Actually Use

Which of these skills are part of your experience?

Rate actual use — not whether you think you are “good” at the skill. Your answers help BOOST see where your experience may transfer.

Step 3 • Your Career Mobility

Where can what you already bring take you?

The careers below are the ones you chose to Reality Check. BOOST adds transferable-skill and preparation evidence; it does not erase what you learned earlier.

WORK NOW = accessible with what you bringMOVE NOW = nearby developmentBUILD TOWARD = larger preparation step

WORK NOW

Careers that may use much of what you already bring with little additional formal preparation.

MOVE NOW

Careers where your skills transfer, but some additional experience, OJT, apprenticeship, or short-term development may help.

BUILD TOWARD

Careers that may fit your interests and regional opportunity but involve a larger education, credential, licensing, or experience step.

OPTIONAL — Show a few other Northern Arizona careers my skills may travel to

To keep exploration efficient, BOOST shows only a small set of additional careers here. Automatic suggestions must meet the Northern Arizona recommendation standard; your own saved careers never have to meet that standard.
